article.title: 新题型 · 公共健康与垃圾食品监管
article.background: 公共健康监管、肥胖与快餐营销。多位专家发言，整体保持新闻报道式节奏。

sentences.en: Leading doctors today weigh in on the debate over the government’s role in promoting public health by demanding that ministers impose “fat taxes” on unhealthy food and introduce cigarette-style warnings to children about the dangers of a poor diet.
sentences.zh: 如今，医学界重量级人物加入了关于政府应在促进公共健康中扮演何种角色的争论。他们要求部长们对不健康食品征收“脂肪税”，并像香烟警示那样，提醒儿童不良饮食的危险。

segments.text: Leading doctors today weigh in on the debate over the government’s role in promoting public health by demanding that ministers impose “fat taxes” on unhealthy food and introduce cigarette-style warnings to children about the dangers of a poor diet.

sentences.en: The demands follow comments made last week by the health secretary, Andrew Lansley, who insisted the government could not force people to make healthy choices and promised to free businesses from public health regulations.
sentences.zh: 这些要求紧随卫生大臣安德鲁·兰斯利上周的言论而来。兰斯利坚持认为，政府不能强迫人们作出健康选择，并承诺让企业摆脱公共卫生方面的监管。

segments.text: The demands follow comments made last week by the health secretary, Andrew Lansley, who insisted the government could not force people to make healthy choices and promised to free businesses from public health regulations.

sentences.en: But senior medical figures want to stop fast-food outlets opening near schools, restrict advertising of products high in fat, salt or sugar, and limit sponsorship of sports events by fast-food producers such as McDonald’s.
sentences.zh: 但资深医学人士希望阻止快餐店在学校附近开业，限制高脂、高盐或高糖食品的广告，并限制麦当劳等快餐企业赞助体育赛事。

segments.text: But senior medical figures want to stop fast-food outlets opening near schools, restrict advertising of products high in fat, salt or sugar, and limit sponsorship of sports events by fast-food producers such as McDonald’s.

sentences.en: They argue that government action is necessary to curb Britain’s addiction to unhealthy food and help halt spiraling rates of obesity, diabetes and heart disease.
sentences.zh: 他们认为，政府有必要采取行动，抑制英国人对不健康食品的依赖，并遏制肥胖、糖尿病和心脏病率不断攀升。

segments.text: They argue that government action is necessary to curb Britain’s addiction to unhealthy food and help halt spiraling rates of obesity, diabetes and heart disease.

sentences.en: Professor Terence Stephenson, president of the Royal College of Paediatrics and Child Health, said that the consumption of unhealthy food should be seen to be just as damaging as somking or excessive drinking.
sentences.zh: 英国皇家儿科与儿童健康学院院长特伦斯·斯蒂芬森教授指出，食用不健康食品的危害应被视为与吸烟或过量饮酒同样严重。

segments.text: Professor Terence Stephenson, president of the Royal College of Paediatrics and Child Health, said that the consumption of unhealthy food should be seen to be just as damaging as somking or excessive drinking.

sentences.en: “Thirty years ago, it would have been inconceivable to have imagined a ban on smoking in the workplace or in pubs, and yet that is what we have now.
sentences.zh: 他说：“三十年前，人们几乎无法想象会禁止在工作场所或酒吧吸烟，可如今这已经成为现实。

vocab.meaning: a. 不能想象的；想不到的

segments.text: “Thirty years ago, it would have been inconceivable to have imagined a ban on smoking in the workplace or in pubs, and yet that is what we have now.

sentences.en: Are we willing to be just as courageous in respect of obesity?
sentences.zh: 面对肥胖问题，我们愿不愿意表现出同样的勇气？

segments.text: Are we willing to be just as courageous in respect of obesity?

sentences.en: I would suggest that we should be,” said the leader of the UK’s children’s doctors.
sentences.zh: 我认为应该。”

segments.text: I would suggest that we should be,” said the leader of the UK’s children’s doctors.

sentences.en: Lansley has alarmed health campaigners by suggesting he wants industry rather than government to take the lead.
sentences.zh: 兰斯利则因暗示希望由行业而非政府主导而令健康倡导者不安。

segments.text: Lansley has alarmed health campaigners by suggesting he wants industry rather than government to take the lead.

sentences.en: He said that manufacturers of crisps and candies could play a central role in the Change4Life campaign, the centrepiece of government efforts to boost healthy eating and fitness.
sentences.zh: 他认为，薯片和糖果生产商可以在Change4Life运动中发挥核心作用，这项运动是政府推动健康饮食和健身的核心项目。

segments.text: He said that manufacturers of crisps and candies could play a central role in the Change4Life campaign, the centrepiece of government efforts to boost healthy eating and fitness.

sentences.en: He has also criticised the celebrity chef Jamie Oliver’s high-profile attempt to improve school lunches in England as an example of how “lecturing” people was not the best way to change their behaviour.
sentences.zh: 他还批评名厨杰米·奥利弗高调改善英格兰学校午餐的尝试，认为“说教”并不是改变人们行为的最佳办法。

segments.text: He has also criticised the celebrity chef Jamie Oliver’s high-profile attempt to improve school lunches in England as an example of how “lecturing” people was not the best way to change their behaviour.

sentences.en: Stephenson suggested potential restrictions could include banning TV advertisements for foods high in fat, salt or sugar before 9 pm and limiting them on billboards or in cinemas.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬森提出，潜在限制可以包括晚上9点前禁止播放高脂、高盐或高糖食品的电视广告，并限制这类广告出现在广告牌和电影院中。

segments.text: Stephenson suggested potential restrictions could include banning TV advertisements for foods high in fat, salt or sugar before 9 pm and limiting them on billboards or in cinemas.

sentences.en: “If we were really bold, we might even begin to think of high-calorie fast food in the same way as cigarettes – by setting strict limits on advertising, product placement and sponsorship of sports events,” he said.
sentences.zh: 他还表示：“如果我们真的足够大胆，甚至可以开始像对待香烟那样对待高热量快餐——严格限制广告、产品植入以及体育赛事赞助。”

segments.text: “If we were really bold, we might even begin to think of high-calorie fast food in the same way as cigarettes – by setting strict limits on advertising, product placement and sponsorship of sports events,” he said.

sentences.en: Such a move could affect firms such as McDonald’s, which sponsors the youth coaching scheme run by the Football Association.
sentences.zh: 这类措施可能影响麦当劳等企业，因为麦当劳赞助英格兰足球总会运营的青少年教练项目。

segments.text: Such a move could affect firms such as McDonald’s, which sponsors the youth coaching scheme run by the Football Association.

sentences.en: Fast-food chains should also stop offering “inducements” such as toys, cute animals and mobile phone credit to lure young customers, Stephenson said.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬森还说，快餐连锁店也应停止用玩具、可爱动物形象、手机话费等“诱因”吸引年轻消费者。

segments.text: Fast-food chains should also stop offering “inducements” such as toys, cute animals and mobile phone credit to lure young customers, Stephenson said.

sentences.en: Professor Dinesh Bhugra, president of the Royal College of Psychiatrists, said: “If children are taught about the impact that food has on their growth, and that some things can harm, at least information is available up front.”
sentences.zh: 英国皇家精神科医学院院长迪内什·布格拉教授说：“如果让孩子了解食物如何影响生长，以及某些东西会带来伤害，至少他们能事先掌握信息。”

vocab.meaning: 精神病医生；精神病学家

segments.text: Professor Dinesh Bhugra, president of the Royal College of Psychiatrists, said: “If children are taught about the impact that food has on their growth, and that some things can harm, at least information is available up front.”

sentences.en: He also urged councils to impose “fast-food-free zones” around schools and hospitals – areas within which takeaways cannot open.
sentences.zh: 他还敦促地方议会在学校和医院周围设立“无快餐区”，禁止外卖店在其中开业。

segments.text: He also urged councils to impose “fast-food-free zones” around schools and hospitals – areas within which takeaways cannot open.

sentences.en: A Department of Health spokesperson said: “We need to create a new vision for public health where all of society works together to get healthy and live longer.
sentences.zh: 卫生部发言人表示：“我们需要建立一种新的公共健康愿景，让全社会共同努力，变得更健康、活得更长。

segments.text: A Department of Health spokesperson said: “We need to create a new vision for public health where all of society works together to get healthy and live longer.

sentences.en: This includes creating a new ‘responsibility deal’ with business, built on social responsibility, not state regulation.
sentences.zh: 这包括与企业建立新的‘责任协议’，以社会责任而非国家监管为基础。

segments.text: This includes creating a new ‘responsibility deal’ with business, built on social responsibility, not state regulation.

sentences.en: Later this year, we will publish a white paper setting out exactly how we will achieve this.”
sentences.zh: 今年晚些时候，我们会发布白皮书，详细说明如何实现这一目标。”

segments.text: Later this year, we will publish a white paper setting out exactly how we will achieve this.”

sentences.en: The food industry will be alarmed that such senior doctors back such radical moves, especially the call to use some of the tough tactics that have been deployed against smoking over the last decade.
sentences.zh: 这些资深医生支持如此激进的措施，尤其是主张采用过去十年对付吸烟时使用的一些强硬手段，势必会让食品行业感到震惊。

segments.text: The food industry will be alarmed that such senior doctors back such radical moves, especially the call to use some of the tough tactics that have been deployed against smoking over the last decade.
